scores.label: A
scores.note: 4 'idealized lives' shifts the idealizing onto the lives and reads oddly after 'believes'; 6 redundant with 'no problems'; 7 plain; 8 leans to the moral sense

scores.label: B
scores.note: 1 'inherently good' is the moral sense; 4 'untainted', 5 'undefiled', 6 'untouched', 7 'pure' are purity senses, wrong meaning; 8, 9, 10 are post-modifiers that are ungrammatical before 'lives'

scores.label: C
scores.note: 4 'exemplary' means worthy of imitation, wrong sense; 7 'pristine', 8 'unsoiled', 9 'spotless' are cleanliness senses; 10 'unsullied' is the reputation sense and too rare
